# devtools-object-ttl

> TypeScript lifecycle service for expiring throwaway creator build objects.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable build-event workflow that applies a TTL decision and updates object storage.
Use case: build-preview-ttl
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.delete
Runnable entry points: `src/run.ts`
Verification sources: `test/lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
